method: Poses sampled from the viewer's own procedural sampler (createProceduralStudySampler) by scripts/sample_animated_study_poses.mjs; every pair whose bounds meet is intersected exactly (Manifold boolean) at the assembled pose and at each sampled pose, skipping pairs of parts that share the same pose change. Touching is allowed, overlap is not; an overlap thinner than max_penetration_mm is treated as mesh tessellation noise on a touching face. Discrete sampling: an overlap narrower than the step could be missed.

shipped_asset.note: The audited GLB is the shipped file unpacked by scripts/decode_model.mjs (EXT_meshopt_compression is lossless), so the auditor can read it.

sampler: src/viewer/core/animated-study-motion.mjs createProceduralStudySampler (apply(motion, progress 0-100); cycle angle = progress x 7.2)

cycle_view_split.note: The core cycle opens in the core view, which shows only the listed parts (some ghosted). The Assembled view shows all 1,396 parts while the same cycle runs, so a pair with a part outside the core view can only be seen there.

exploded_layout_informational.note: Exploded layouts move parts in straight stages, so transit overlaps are expected and do not decide the result (docs/assembly-interference.md, exploded-view exception). Listed to show what the layouts contain.

audited_plain_form.note: The audited GLB is the shipped file unpacked by scripts/decode_model.mjs (EXT_meshopt_compression is lossless), so the auditor can read it.

known_defects.ledger: Real geometry, seen only once the gears turn (found 20 October 2026, after the held-fixed parts were fixed). The accessory idler gear (z -48 to -36 mm, tip radius 56.75 mm) and the right magneto gear (teeth z -37 to -25 mm, tip radius 30.8 mm) overlap axially by 1 mm and their axes are 86.8 mm apart, so their tooth tips pass through each other by up to 0.75 mm radially (0.35 mm thick, about 1.5 mm3) at some crank angles. The two gears are not meant to mesh: the idler gear at z -36 to -24 drives the magneto gear, the accessory idler gear drives the separate accessory gears. Not a motion error: with the declared rates every meshing pair of the train stays clear in all 144 sampled poses.
